candidates.change_summary: Change blockAssertion from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change discardOracle from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change validateDisputers from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change the return value of isDisputeAllowed from true to false.
Insert a return statement in the empty body of getPrice so it returns 1 instead of the default 0.
Insert a return statement in the empty body of getPrice so it returns -1 instead of the default 0.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from requestPrice so any caller can emit PriceRequestAdded.
Invert the require condition so calls from the optimistic asserter revert while all other callers pass.
Delete the require statement so the modifier becomes a no-op and any caller can invoke guarded functions.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionResolvedCallback so any caller can invoke it without reverting.
Delete the `_;` statement in onlyOptimisticAsserter so the guarded function body never executes and non-asserter calls no longer revert.
Invert the access check to `msg.sender != address(optimisticAsserter)` so calls from the real asserter revert while calls from any other address pass.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionDisputedCallback so any caller can execute it instead of reverting.
Insert an emission of PriceRequestAdded inside assertionDisputedCallback so calls produce an observable event.
Invert the sender check in the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so only non-asserter callers pass and the actual asserter reverts.
